section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. This comparison was run at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 4. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 146 | 300 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Blood pressure control | 195 | 300 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
